# AWS semantic gap register

Generated by `node scripts/aws-semantic-audit.cjs`; edit [review decisions](aws-semantic-decisions.json), then regenerate. Method, priorities, representative verification and limitations: [audit guide](aws-semantic-audit.md).

Baseline: AWS Provider 6.70.0, commit `5e13eedee7c22ac362e6ffdfbdcfd23a5f9f797f`; 1742 managed types. Each exact type occurs once, grouped by official service package.

Current defaults are copied from the runtime-generated support matrix. **Implemented** below means basic classification/display/scope eligibility only. **Partial** means pre-existing behavior needs the capability-specific limits in the linked guide; it is never a completeness score. **Basic-only** means no dedicated behavior established here. Candidate fields are schema inputs, not verified relationships or a recommendation to expose values.
